features: Compresses the monitor title, version, subtitle and runtime status chips into one horizontal summary row.
Turns the top LIVE WATCH strip into a slow continuous marquee.
Shrinks Return Terminal and Resync actions to the marquee height and aligns them on the same top row.
Reduces header vertical spacing and expands the split watch table viewport to show more symbols without changing monitor logic.
Keeps the CRYPTO / RWA split, TradingView Scanner refresh behavior and fixed add-symbol control unchanged.
